name: Trygve Lie
note: Term extended by the General Assembly in 1950 after the Council could not agree on an appointment.

name: Dag Hammarskjöld
note: Killed in a plane crash near Ndola (now Zambia) while on a peace mission to the Congo; awarded the Nobel Peace Prize posthumously in 1961.

name: U Thant
note: First Secretary-General from Asia. Acting Secretary-General until appointed to a full term on 30 November 1962. His country was then known as Burma.

name: Kurt Waldheim
note: A bid for a third term in 1981 was blocked in the Council.

name: Javier Pérez de Cuéllar
note: Only Secretary-General from Latin America and the Caribbean to date.

name: Boutros Boutros-Ghali
note: First Secretary-General from Africa. A second term was vetoed by the United States in 1996, making his the shortest tenure of any Secretary-General.

name: Kofi Annan
note: First Secretary-General to rise from within the UN staff; awarded the Nobel Peace Prize jointly with the United Nations in 2001.
